text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After the race, Yaeno Muteki praises Oguri 
Cap for regaining her true way of running.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap expressed her gratitude, saying 
how glad she was to have Yaeno Muteki as a 
rival.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, the two exchanged a promise to 
continue running together from then on.
